raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Fix Qwen3.5 GatedDeltaNet initialization in Ascend images without FLA-NPU by loading the selected MindSpeed GDN operators for FSDP and Megatron. Update the A2/A3 MindSpeed, MegatronAdaptor, and TransformerEngineNPU source pins, cap PyArrow below 26 for the image's NumPy 1.26 runtime, and require Trackio >=0.35.0 to avoid resolver backtracking to an obsolete release.

## Related Issue

No linked issue.

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [x] Self-reviewed via the `review-pr` skill
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via the `create-pr` skill
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):** Not applicable.

## Additional Context

Targets `ascend`; the head commit is directly based on the current upstream `ascend` tip.

Validation: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_mindspeed_gdn_patch.py` passed all six tests. Whitespace checks passed. Read-only checks in an Ascend development container confirmed the three updated dependency revisions and successful FSDP/Megatron operator imports and bindings with FLA-NPU absent.

Risk: the dependency pin updates affect broader runtime paths. Full pre-commit was not rerun during this review/publication, and no image rebuild, numerical training, or distributed qualification was performed during this review.

 ``mindspeed.megatron_adaptor`` (which binds ``l2norm`` into ``fla.modules``). No-op
 without MindSpeed; tracked in-repo so it survives image rebuilds.
 
+Covers MindSpeed's own l2norm only. MindSpeed's GDN backend selector sources
+l2norm from ``fla_npu`` when that package is installed, which bypasses this patch;
+the NPU images deliberately omit fla_npu, so the MindSpeed backend is what runs.
+
 Also despecializes ``NT`` in the GDN chunk kernels (``_despecialize_chunk_nt``) so
 they compile once across sequence lengths instead of recompiling per seqlen -- the
 dominant per-new-seqlen chunk cost. All three are runtime-free compile-once wins.
